parsed.why: Strong operating equality court, 2024 hate-crime act and 2025 detention-care ruling; but patterned township violence against trans people, document-mismatch humiliation, unresolved facility access and police mockery offset it.

Self-ID recognition, gender-identity anti-discrimination law covering public establishments, no criminalisation or targeting; friction limited to low-level bias counts, missing hate-crime classification system and one corrected transphobic column.

Decriminalisation came only in 2024 by reading-down; no identity protections, dismissive police refusing LGBT victims, documented slurs and killing, hostility aimed at LGBT visitors. No trans-specific record forces structural extrapolation.

No trans criminalisation or documented targeting, but no discrimination or hate-crime law, stalled reforms, surgery-only recognition, officially reinforced religious opposition; positives limited to one accepting indigenous territory.

Appearance-based arrests with five-year maximum sentences actually imposed on trans women in 2021, security-force sweeps for gender nonconformity, beatings in custody, raided NGO, no lawyers — state-tolerated targeting.
